description: Select an option from a native <select> dropdown element. Use this instead of click for <select> elements, as native dropdowns cannot be controlled via click events.

label.description: The visible text of the option to select (matches <option> text content).

ref.description: Element reference from snapshot (the number after ref=).

tab.description: The tab to drive: a handle of this session such as "t2" (list_tabs, new_tab). Default: the session's current tab.

value.description: The option value to select (matches <option value="...">).

name: select_option
